name: ui-grid-editor
description: Editor for ui-grid layouts: drag items between cells, merge / split cells, add / remove rows and columns, save as JSON.

descriptions.--ui-grid-editor-boundary-size: Width / height of the toolbars between rows and columns.
descriptions.--ui-grid-editor-item-gap: Space between the items of a cell.
descriptions.--ui-grid-editor-area-border-color: Border colour of a cell (dashed when empty).
descriptions.--ui-grid-editor-empty-color: Text colour of the empty-cell note.
descriptions.--ui-grid-editor-drop-color: Outline of the cell under a dragged item.
descriptions.--ui-grid-editor-line-color: Colour of the dotted row / column lines.
